## Constitution checklist

- [ ] **Test-first**: tests were written first and failed before the implementation (Principle I)
- [ ] **Separation of concerns**: shared/domain, providers, services, routes, and UI stay in their layers (Principle II)
- [ ] **Documentation**: contracts, ADRs (`docs/adr/`), and README updated where relevant (Principle III)
- [ ] **Incremental**: this PR is a small, independently reviewable increment (Principle IV)
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, and `npm run test:e2e` pass locally
- [ ] At least one reviewer assigned (Principle V)
